children.label: If we take nothing from the agent, how does this work?

data.heading: If we take nothing from the agent,

data.body: It is the first thing people ask, and it should be. We are not paid by agents and we take no share of their commission, so no agent can buy their way onto your shortlist. That is the whole reason a shortlist from us is worth reading — there is nothing in it for us if you choose one over another.

checks: No agent pays us to appear on your shortlist, and none can.
We take no share of the commission you end up paying.
You are told what our own fee is before we start, not after.
If you decide not to sell, that is a perfectly good outcome and it costs you nothing.

data.heading: Ready to find
data.body: Start with a free, no‑pressure conversation. We’ll help you understand your options — and only move forward when it feels right.
